summary: Petrobras, through its subsidiary PGF, filed a Form 6-K announcing the redemption of $670M aggregate principal amount of its 7.375% Global Notes due 2027. The redemption date is June 26, 2026; the redemption price is the greater of 100% of principal or a make-whole amount based on Treasury Rate plus 50 bps, plus accrued interest from January 17, 2026. Funds will come from available cash. The notes and related guaranty will be cancelled upon payment. This is a debt tender/call, effectively an issuer tender offer for its own securities. Watch for the make-whole calculation on the third business day before redemption and whether any holders tender early.
